title.narrative: Increased capacity in internal audit, number of certified auditors

description.narrative: Increased capacity in internal audit, number of certified auditors

comment.narrative: Baseline No person was trained 0
Final target 70 personsAs of July 8 2021 a total of 158 people passed the exam and received certificates of which 96 people work as auditors in the civil service.

Achieved. Out of 240 internal auditors who received the training 178 auditors passed the exam and were issued internal audit certificates. At the projects closure 72 professionals work in internal audit in the public sector.

description.narrative: Intergovernmental Fiscal Relations and SubNational PFM

title.narrative: Equalization power of the intergovernmental fiscal transfers formula improved

description.narrative: Equalization power of the intergovernmental fiscal transfers formula improved

comment.narrative: Baseline 165317
Final target Reduced by 15 compared to the baseline value

Not achieved. The Bankexecuted TF supported the review of the equalization grants formula the MoF was provided with recommendations for its improvement. Nevertheless the authorities opted to use their own formula which was further simplified under the political pressure from parliamentarians and other government officials. The MoFs assessment of the indicator used the same approach as in the baseline calculations and showed a steady increase deterioration of the standard deviation from 1654 som in 2017 to 2488 in 2021. However the increases in nominal values might be driven by inflation and economic growth rather than the underlying inequality. To make a more meaningful comparison across years the WB team looked at the standard deviation expressed as a percentage of the average per capita amount of resources i.e. the coefficient of variation. According to the coefficient of variation the disparities were steadily decreasing in 20172019 102 94 and 87 percent but started to increase again in 2020 with a particularly large spike in 2021 reaching 110 percent of the average per capita amount of resources.

title.narrative: System of intergovernmental fiscal relations improved

description.narrative: System of intergovernmental fiscal relations improved

comment.narrative: Baseline No vision to improve intergovernmental transfer system.

Final target The system of intergovernmental fiscal relations improved based on the project recommendations is fully operational.The contract with a consulting firm package 2 to assist the MoEF in this area was signed on May 11 2021. The firm submitted an inception report to the MoEF on June 23 2021. The report is currently under the MoEFs review.Three subnational PEFA assessments that will help identify gaps and provide recommendations for improvement were finalized in late December 2021 and to be made publicly available through the PEFA Secretariat website.

Not achieved. Operationalization of the Projects recommendations is likely to take place outside the Projects timeline including with potential support from the follow up project requested by the authorities.

description.narrative: Project Management

title.narrative: The PIST is fully staffed and preforms its duties timely and with adequate quality

description.narrative: The PIST is fully staffed and preforms its duties timely and with adequate quality

comment.narrative: Baseline PIST does not exist

Final target The PIST is fully staffed and preforms its duties timely and with adequate qualityProject implementation function transferred to the CLMU the existing PIU under MoF. The CLMU is adequately staffed to efficiently perform its duties.

Achieved. Project implementation function was transferred to the Credit Line Management Unit CLMU under the MoF on October 11 2019. The CLMU is a centralized and experienced PIU adequately staffed to efficiently perform its duties. The CLMU also supports other projects implemented by the MoF. Between November 2019 and August 2022 the project was supported on timesharing basis by seven specialists of the PIU six staff dealing with fiduciary aspects and one staff on thematic aspects of the project. This proved useful in the period of high staff turnover during 20192020 when the PIU had to train the newly hired MoF staff on WB procedures.

description.narrative: Strengthening budget planning and execution

title.narrative: Increased public participation in budget process, an OBI participation score

description.narrative: Increased public participation in budget process, an OBI participation score

comment.narrative: Source OBI 2019. While questions used in the OBI 2017 assessment have changed and a direct comparison of 2017 and 2019 scores may be misleading improvement of the score between 2017 31 and 2019 33 shows positive trend.
Final target 57 out of 100 20192020.The questions used to compute this score have changed therefore the endofproject value may need to be revisited.

At least partially achieved. The OBI methodology used for assessing the public participation in the different stages of the budget process has changed starting with 2017 assessment therefore direct comparison with 2015 baseline is not feasible. The 2019 and 2021 OBI reports acknowledge that Kyrgyz Republics progress in establishing public consultations during budget formulation and public hearings at Supreme Council related to the approval of the annual budget. According to the new methodology the scores for the public participation in the budget process constituted 31 2017 33 2019. This is higher than the global average scores of 12 14 and 14 in the respective years but suggests slippage of the public participation in the budget process in Kyrgyz Republic relative to other countries by the end of 2020 period covered by 2021 OBI. The backsliding to 26 out of 100 in 2021 is to large extent due to the lack of opportunities for facetoface participation in the budget process during the COVID19 lockdowns as well as changes in comparator countries scores.

description.narrative: Diminished stock of expenditure payment arrears as a share of central budget expenditures

comment.narrative: Aggregate stock of expenditure arrears without membership fees to international organizations of total expenditure. 2019 data.Calculations will be updated based on the MoFprovided data to be available in Q2 2022.
Final target is Not more than 3

Achieved. Calculations are based on republican budget execution data provided by the MoF. The indicator is calculated as a share of aggregate stock of expenditure arrears without membership fees to international organizations in total republican budget expenditures. The indicator stayed above the 2017 baseline of 4.5 throughout the project 5.5 in 2018 6.1 in 2019 4.2 in 2020 and reached its 3 target by the end of 2021.

title.narrative: Decreased variance in functional composition of expenditure outturn

description.narrative: Decreased variance in functional composition of expenditure outturn

comment.narrative: Calculations are based on the 2020 data provided by the MoEF.Calculations will be updated based on the MoFprovided data to be available in Q2 2022.
Reduction by at least 7 seven percentage points compared to baseline

Not achieved. Calculations are based on republican budget execution data provided by the MoF. Variance of the functional composition of the republican budget expenditures constituted 15.2 in 2019 15.8 in 2020 and 11.4 in 2021. One of the factors why the Project had not succeeded in achieving the indicator relates to delays with the launch and implementation of consultancies. Other factors outside the Project also undermined its ability to reach the target these include the COVID19 pandemic and regional macroeconomic shocks that affected allocation and inyear reallocation of budget spending.
